name: Inakawa (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Inakawa town emblem in white: a winged ring enclosing a stylised letter V, with three bars at the bottom.
history: Flag of the former town of Inakawa in Akita Prefecture, dissolved on 2005-03-22.

features.role: Inakawa town emblem — a winged ring enclosing a stylised letter V, with three bars at the bottom
